section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Rear Suspension
title: Coil Spring and Rear Shock Absorber

content.text: REMOVAL OF COIL SPRING AND SHOCK ABSORBER

content.description: Vehicle jacked up showing differential carrier assembly and rear suspension member supported with jack stands

items.heading: JACK UP VEHICLE
items.text: Jack up the differential carrier assembly and support the rear suspension member with stands.

content.description: Rear suspension showing brake hose clips and stabilizer bar end connection points

items.heading: REMOVE STABILIZER BAR END
items.text: Disconnect the nut, cushion and retainer from suspension arm.

content.description: Removal of drive shaft nut from rear hub assembly

items.heading: REMOVE DRIVE SHAFT
items.text: Remove the nut holding the rear drive shaft.

content.description: Suspension arm with jack placement point indicated

items.heading: LEAVE A JACK UNDER SUSPENSION ARM

content.description: Bolt holding shock absorber to suspension arm with shock absorber connection detail

items.heading: REMOVE REAR SHOCK ABSORBER
items.text: (a) Remove the bolt holding the shock absorber to the rear suspension arm and disconnect the shock absorber.
